plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering overall leverage. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.
